name: Hertie School: Human Rights Scholarship
summary: The Human Rights Scholarship from the Hertie School is a full tuition scholarship, available for applicants of all nationalities who wish to pursue a 2-year, full-time, Master of International Affairs programme taught in English in Berlin,
